cc:Work.dc:title: Ordered binary matrix removal: 66×66 → 3×4
cc:Work.dc:description: Selected patterns 66×66, 15×15, 5×5, 4×4, 3×4 have 4356, 225, 25, 16, 12 entries. Logarithmic vertical scale; categorical size order, not publication dates. Erebos has the earlier 4×4 theorem; ProveIt has earlier 5×5 work and the H4 candidate. The current 3×4 main theorem is Lean checked; independent review remains pending.
